### Keeping My New Year's Resolutions to Myself
Author: Glynnis Whitwer
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-jan-5-2011-11643606.html
Passage: 1 Kings 20:11
Points:
- Announcing personal goals often gives an unearned feeling of accomplishment before doing the actual work.
- Ahab warned Ben-hadad that a soldier strapping on armor should not boast like one taking it off.
- Empty words mean little without the steadfast daily discipline needed to finish the task.
- Rather than broadcasting ambitions for praise, believers should quietly focus on obeying God's present callings.
